research_boundary.oos_opening_condition: the two-specialist trained threshold pair must pass every frozen pre-2024 materiality and economic gate
research_boundary.known_contamination: Historical PPOSM OOS windows were exposed by prior research. This experiment is research-only and cannot authorize deployment.

architecture.name: two_action_specialist_lifecycle_residual_router

experts.SKIP: independent Qwen LoRA SFT plus residual-utility RLVR trained only on SKIP-vs-TP4 lifecycle rows
experts.TP12: independent Qwen LoRA SFT plus residual-utility RLVR trained only on TP12-vs-TP4 lifecycle rows

architecture.motivation: the shared adapter failed pre-2024 separation for both action families; independent experts remove cross-action representation interference without using OOS evidence

per_specialist_rlvr.utility_scale: candidate-specific median nonzero absolute lifecycle switch utility frozen in source.specialists

train_only_threshold_pair.scores: each specialist emits its own SWITCH-minus-KEEP mean label-logprob margin on its 102 pre-2024 rows
train_only_threshold_pair.grid: Cartesian product of each specialist's distinct margins plus nextafter sentinels
train_only_threshold_pair.strict_switch: candidate margin > its own frozen threshold
train_only_threshold_pair.dual_switch_resolution: choose larger normalized excess margin (margin minus its candidate threshold); exact tie SKIP
objective_order: maximize min(base CAGR/MDD delta, stress CAGR/MDD delta)
maximize min(base log-equity delta, stress log-equity delta)
train_only_threshold_pair.no_feasible_pair: record a train-stage failure and stop before generating or scoring OOS prompts

oos_protocol_if_train_passes.prompt_rows: always-TP4 shadow anchors only, no target/utility/future portfolio metrics
oos_protocol_if_train_passes.score_binding: SKIP prompts only with SKIP specialist; TP12 prompts only with TP12 specialist
oos_protocol_if_train_passes.routing: single frozen threshold pair and dual-switch rule; all nonanchors TP4
oos_protocol_if_train_passes.execution: exact next 5-minute open, TP/stop/48-hour cap, funding, non-overlap

stopping_rule: No OOS prompt generation/scoring unless the independent specialist threshold pair passes every pre-2024 gate; no model, threshold, or route repair after OOS.
